design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g., deep blue) for table headers, pull-quote border, and industry snapshot stat values.
Tables: hairline rules, left-aligned text in first column, right-aligned numbers in subsequent columns.
Pull-quote: set in a larger serif italic, with a left hairline rule in accent colour.
Industry snapshot: stat strip with three boxes; growth bars proportional to width; split bar with percentage labels.
Sidebar: boxed with a thin border, smaller serif type, no background fill.
